The boundaries of these five books are marked by concluding doxologies. Book 1 concludes with the doxology in 41:13 [41:14]: "Praise be to Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen." Books 2, 3, and 4 close with similar doxologies (72:18-20; 89:52 [89:53]; 106:48). And book 5 concludes with the doxological Psalm 150, or perhaps with the entire series of final "Hallelujah Psalms" Psalms 146-50.
